configurations.name: Run Extension
configurations.comment: Launch an Extension Development Host with this extension loaded (F5). Compiles the TypeScript first via the `compile` task.

configurations.name: Quilon: debug current file
configurations.comment: Builds the active .qn with `quilon build --debug` and debugs it under CodeLLDB. Breakpoints set in the .qn source are hit via the DWARF line table.
